mapper.select: SELECT * FROM external_api_config ORDER BY display_name, id
SELECT * FROM external_api_config WHERE api_code = #{apiCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_api_config (api_code, display_name, base_url, auth_type, credential_secret, config_json, timeout_ms, enabled) VALUES (#{apiCode}, #{displayName}, #{baseUrl}, #{authType}, #{credentialSecret}, #{configJson}, #{timeoutMs}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE external_api_config SET display_name = #{displayName}, base_url = #{baseUrl}, auth_type = #{authType}, credential_secret = #{credentialSecret}, config_json = #{configJson}, timeout_ms = #{timeoutMs}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
